title: Special provisions near certain parks
previewText: The provisions of Section 42-65 (Additional Regulations for Signs Near Certain Parks and Designated Arterial Highways) shall not apply to any signs provided in accordance with Section 144-141 (Illuminated non-flashing signage) within the Barge Basin East Subarea.
